product were similar in the fasted, standard breakfast fed and enteral nutrition formula fed states, the bioavailability of elvitegravir
was signiﬁcantly greater in the fed state regardless of nutrient content. As a result, this combination antiviral product is best admin-
istered with a meal.
The macronutrient content of a meal may make a difference on the effect. For example, the fat component (percent energy)
may have signiﬁcant inﬂuence on oral bioavailability of a drug, as with the antifungal drug griseofulvin. The oral bioavailability
increases between 35% and 120% with a meal depending speciﬁcally on fat content, compared to its administration in the
fasted state (Ogunbona et al., 1985). Bioavailability of ivermectin increased 2.5-fold when administered with a meal, espe-
cially with a high-fat meal (Guzzo et al., 2002; Raman and Polli, 2016) which may be related to altered post-absorptive distri-
bution as well as improved gut dissolution following a high-fat meal (Miyajima et al., 2015). However, administration of
ivermectin with a grain-based meal did not alter bioavailability from that in the fasted state (Homeida et al., 2013). Even
the content of pectin in a meal may alter drug absorption usually through an inﬂuence on permeability in part by bile salt
modiﬁcation (Elshahed et al., 2021).
